title: Atelier agent-models configuration
description: Maps each Atelier agent id to a model key (the value at runtime comes from this per-machine file, never from this repo). Edit freely; takes effect on next server start.

default.description: Fallback model key for any agent id not listed in 'models'.

models.description: Per-agent model overrides. Key = agent id (atlas, forge, lens, echo, trainer, ...). Value = model key from opencode.json provider section.

presets.description: Named model aliases you can reference by 'preset:<name>' in the 'models' map.
